summary: Donalds is positioning his Florida gubernatorial campaign as pro-Israel, per JNS, and the Jewish Times characterizes him as a 'Pro-Israel Candidate.' He equated campus anti-Semitism perpetrators with 'Hamas apologists' in 2024 and labeled Hamas 'terrorists' in an anniversary release. An April 2025 town hall turned contentious when constituents pressed him on the Israel-Hamas war. His Nay vote on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, carries no stated rationale and does not offset this consistent pro-Israel posture.
